fidelity: F2a — Distributed-Parameter / Cascaded-Pi Lumped Dynamic Model
source: Glover, Sarma & Overbye (2012) Power System Analysis and Design 5th ed., Cengage; Bergen & Vittal (2000) Power Systems Analysis 2nd ed., Prentice Hall

unit.name: Generic 230 kV ACSR Overhead Transmission Line — Distributed Parameter

r_ohm_per_km.note: Series resistance per km (230 kV ACSR, ~50 C)

L_mH_per_km.note: Series inductance per km (x = 0.352 ohm/km @ 60 Hz)

C_nF_per_km.note: Shunt capacitance per km (b = 4.8e-6 S/km @ 60 Hz)

G_uS_per_km.note: Shunt conductance per km (leakage/corona, ~0 for OH line)
